answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents must lock 1,000 unique keys to demonstrate a delta of genuine presence against the network baseline. The verifier functions like a lantern, scanning active proof-traces to purge any duplicates, while each credential remains valid only for a 90-day cycle. An honest participant pays one unit for entry; meanwhile, 1,000 fakes must use a quill of registry that reveals their shared, non-recoverable debt.
